thread:
ernie-cs: Quick thread NimbleGrid renewal stuck on billing: customer wants invoice to NimbleGrid GmbH (DE) but payment will be made by NimbleGrid Inc (US card). They need the invoice today to close FY procurement. Can legal/ops advise?

paul-am: Are they changing term/pricing? Any credits requested?

ernie-cs: They want to keep 12mo but asked for a 15% one-time "partner onboarding" credit if we accept mixed-entity billing and net60. PO: NG-PO-5510. Signer: "Helena M., Head of Procurement".

rina-legal: Mixed-entity payments OK w/conditions. We need either (A) DE VAT ID for billed entity and vendor code, or (B) signed remit authorization + indemnity clause. For DE we can accept DocuSign but may require explicit language about VAT responsibility.

joey-ops: Finance: we prefer wire to our DE account. If they must use US card we require vendor code + completed tax form. Also we need payor authorization on file if payer differs from billed entity. Note: German bank holidays might delay clearance; do they have a target clear-by date?

ernie-cs: Customer gave vendor code NG-VC-210 and their billing contact billing@g.nimblegrid.co. They said wire preferred, fallback to US card if wire delayed. Target: funds clear by 2024-06-15 or they push renewal to next quarter.

paul-am: I'll log the 15% credit request but hold approval pending legal/finance risk. If indemnity required we likely can't offer credit.

rina-legal: Draft addendum language ready: ```Billing Entity & Tax Responsibility: Customer confirms NimbleGrid GmbH is the billed entity. NimbleGrid Inc authorizes payment on behalf of NimbleGrid GmbH. Customer will provide VAT registration number or indemnify Redwood Inference against VAT, penalties, or interest resulting from incorrect billing entity information.```

joey-ops: I'll prepare two invoice templates: (1) EUR invoice to NimbleGrid GmbH with DE VAT line + DE wire instructions, (2) EUR invoice with separate payor field (NimbleGrid Inc) and CC fallback note. Holding send until addendum signed or VAT proof received. ETA 25m.

ernie-cs: Sent DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/NG-EN-5510 (sent). Asked them to sign and confirm wire details.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope NG-EN-5510 status: sent (1 pending signer). View: https://docusign.com/envelope/NG-EN-5510

paul-am: If they push for the 15% we should model the $ impact and consider a one-time invoice credit rather than recurring discount. I'll prepare numbers if legal gives the green light.

ernie-cs: Customer replied: they'll try wire today and sign addendum. If wire not cleared by 6/15 they'll auto-charge the US card as backup. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
